title: Normalized integral compact-support scalar isomorphisms
statement:
Let $K_0$ be a field, $X,Y$ finite-type $K_0$-schemes, and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $K_0$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a prime $\ell$ invertible in $K_0$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a compactification $c$ of $f$. At every finite subextension $A/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\Omega$, use the derived-complete integral categories $\mathcal C_A^Z=D^b_c(Z,\mathcal O_A)$ and their raw Hom scalar localizations $\mathcal D_A^Z=D^b_c(Z,A)$, for $Z=X,Y$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Let $F_A:\mathcal C_A^X\to\mathcal C_A^Y$ and $G_A:\mathcal D_A^X\to\mathcal D_A^Y$ be the fixed normalized compact-support functors of [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action]: their objects are the values of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], and $G_A(a\otimes v)=a\otimes F_A(v)$. Write $\widehat T^Z_{B/A}$ for completed integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], and $T^Z_{B/A}$ for its raw rationalization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi].

For each inclusion $A\subseteq B$ there is an integral natural isomorphism
$$b_{B/A}:\widehat T^Y_{B/A}F_A\xrightarrow{\sim}F_B\widehat T^X_{B/A}.$$
The isomorphisms have the following prescribed normalization of [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action]. At each $K\in\mathcal C_A^X$ and $n\geq0$, put $R_n=\mathcal O_A/(\varpi_A^{n+1})$, $S_n=\mathcal O_B/(\varpi_B^{n+1})$, let $\iota_n:R_n\to S_n$ be the inclusion-induced map, and let $\operatorname{Res}_{\iota_n}$ denote restriction of scalars. Write $r_{A,n}$ for the specified reduction isomorphism of $F_A$, and $\eta_{Z,n}$ for the mixed completed tensor unit of [def-weil-mixed-reduction-unit]. On sheafified tensors the underlying mixed unit is $s\otimes x\mapsto\iota_n(s)\otimes(1\otimes x)$; its derived normalization is the full homotopy-category square with universal reduction counits and the prescribed diagonal Roos map. Set
$$M=(\widehat T^X_{B/A}K)_n,\qquad N=(\widehat T^Y_{B/A}F_AK)_n,\qquad
\eta_N=\eta_{Y,n,F_AK}\circ r_{A,n,K}^{-1}.$$
Then precomposition with $\eta_N$ gives a bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{S_n}(N,Z)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_{R_n}(Rf^c_{!,A,n}K_n,\operatorname{Res}_{\iota_n}Z)$$
for every derived $S_n$-coefficient object $Z$ on $Y$. Moreover $r_{B,n,\widehat T^X_{B/A}K}\circ(b_{B/A,K})_n:N\to Rf^c_{!,B,n}M$ is the unique map whose composite with $\eta_N$ is compact support of $\eta_{X,n,K}$ followed by the specified scalar-restriction comparison. These transformations are realized on the fixed strict reduction towers and their normalized derived limits, retaining the entire homotopy-category normalization, not just their degreewise cohomology maps. Raw localization of these integral maps is a natural isomorphism
$$\beta_{B/A}:T^Y_{B/A}G_A\xrightarrow{\sim}G_BT^X_{B/A}.$$
This assertion supplies normalized comparisons for individual inclusions; it makes no tower-coherence or common-stage independence assertion.

proof.text: Form the ambient natural transformation by whiskering compactRealization with completed scalar extension, composing the specified coefficientExchange for systemCompactScalar, and composing the inverse target compactRealization. Lift its components and naturality into the full constructible subcategory. By lem-sf-compact-support-coefficient-exchange-invertible the middle components are invertible; the outer components are already isomorphisms. Full-subcategory reflection and componentwise invertibility give an integral natural isomorphism b. Its ambient component is definitionally sfCompactSupportScalarSystemMap. Transport residue-field units from the given base-field unit.

Apply lem-sf-compact-support-finite-scalar-mate-normalization to b and its literal component equation to obtain SfCompactSupportIntegralBetaSpec. Apply the proved lem-sf-compact-support-rational-scalar-iso to b to obtain the rational comparison and HEq component formula. Package these three conjuncts with the constructed b.

The rational HEq is provable from the object equality in the sfRationalScalarExtension spec and mirrors the reviewed rationalBeta field. Residue Invertible helper is transported from hl (data, not a hypothesis). Statement verbatim, declarations complete, all dep modules imported, one sorry, docstrings present, live delta = lean field only, no duplicate.
